mechanism: NSAIDs like diclofenac can increase infection risk in patients on immunosuppressive therapy (vedolizumab is an integrin antagonist reducing immune function) and may impair renal function, affecting drug clearance.
action: Monitor for signs of infection and renal function; consider alternative analgesia (acetaminophen, topical NSAIDs) if prolonged diclofenac use is anticipated in vedolizumab-treated patients.
